main_text.l: obedire huic vel illi Præcepto, est actus
Præceptum illud fuerit juris ipsi Deo naturalis,
sive liberi & positivi: ut enim omnia &
obligant eos, quibus præscribuntur; sic vir-
tutis est obedientiam illis præstare; non
abstinebant à suillâ, verè peccabant; & ma-
cul dubio, per istam suam inobedientiam.
Peccata enim venialia non agnoscit The-
credunt, verè etiam peccant, atque isto
Hi, contra primum Præceptum, quo obli-
gantur credere quæcunque sibi à Deo

page.notes: Catchword at the foot right: "caverit," printed after the last line. Printed text partly obscured by specks; "abstinebant" appears in the print as "ab-stinebant" with a hyphen at the line end. Words with doubtful letters: "suillâ" and "quæcunque" are read from a degraded scan.
